label: FB: Run in Xfce Terminal
command: xfce4-terminal --working-directory="$ZED_DIRNAME" --title="FreeBASIC" -x bash -c 'cd "'"$ZED_DIRNAME"'" && "./'"$ZED_STEM"'"; ec=$?; echo; echo "--- program exited with code $ec ---"; read -n 1 -s -r -p "Press any key to close..."'

label: FB: Build (console) + Run in Xfce Terminal
command: fbc -s console -exx -w all "$ZED_FILE" && xfce4-terminal --working-directory="$ZED_DIRNAME" --title="FreeBASIC" -x bash -c 'cd "'"$ZED_DIRNAME"'" && "./'"$ZED_STEM"'"; ec=$?; echo; echo "--- program exited with code $ec ---"; read -n 1 -s -r -p "Press any key to close..."'
